Title: Private Link for Azure Database for PostgreSQL Single Server is now available

Body.Content:
Azure Private Link support for Azure Database for PostgreSQL Single Server is now generally available. Private Link enables you to connect to your PostgreSQL server via a private endpoint. Use it to establish cross-premises access to the private endpoint using ExpressRoute, private peering, or VPN tunneling—or choose to disable all access via a public endpoint.

Learn more about Private Link for Azure Database for PostgreSQL Single Server.
